E1.evidence: The issue gives reproduction steps (build CARLA ros-bridge, load rviz_carla_plugin) and the error "rviz2: symbol lookup error: /home/felipe/Documents/Github/carla_ws/install/rviz_carla_plugin/lib/librviz_carla_plugin.so: undefined symbol: _ZN3tf27fromMsgERKN13geometry_msgs3msg11Quaternion_ISaIvEEERNS_10QuaternionE", with objdump output; a maintainer explains: "Yes, you need to have this definition.  It is generally provided by tf2_geometry_msgs". Reporter's tf2 version: "0.25.5-1jammy.20231117.203705" (Humble binaries).

E2.evidence:
Units: the rviz2 plugin rviz_carla_plugin calls tf2's header API (tf2/utils.h), whose implementation calls a function tf2 only declares: "// Forward declare functions needed in this header
void fromMsg(const geometry_msgs::msg::Quaternion & in, tf2::Quaternion & out);" (tf2/impl/utils.h@b9b06ecb); the definition is supplied by the tf2_geometry_msgs header. The failure depends on that header-level requirement, so it is not internal (step 2), and it is not a launch/config name binding (step 3). The resolving change only adds the missing dependency: "+  find_package(tf2_geometry_msgs REQUIRED)", "+                            tf2_geometry_msgs)" in ament_target_dependencies, and "+#include <tf2_geometry_msgs/tf2_geometry_msgs.hpp>" before "#include <tf2/utils.h>" (FelipeGdM/ros-bridge 381c403c and 9be6dfe2, identical changes on two parents). Neither tf2's declared API nor the plugin's calls change; the fix is dependency resolution (build configuration plus a header include providing the definition), so the case stops at step 4. The maintainer states the upstream alternative is blocked by dependency structure: "it creates a circular dependency between `tf2_geometry_msgs` and `tf2`". A second consumer with the same missing dependency, mikeferguson/graceful_controller on Iron (tf2 0.31.5), was fixed the same way (#include of tf2_geometry_msgs.hpp in commit f08b884d, PR #71 "fix build when RelWithDebInfo"); no upstream tf2 change was made.

E3.evidence: PAIR: the plugin, loaded into rviz2, calls tf2's header functions (tf2::getYaw path per a commenter: "Use tf2::getYaw<geometry_msgs::msg::Quaternion>" ... "Which then calls fromMsg(geometry_msgs::msg::Quaternion, tf2::Quaternion)").

E4.evidence: Observed crash: "Rviz2 crashes with the message:" followed by the symbol lookup error quoted above.
